# ARM v2 conditional research package

Start with ARM-v2.html for complete source-linked English and Simplified Chinese research. March 31, 2026 capital/discount origin; October 19 information. Exact 1,064.055252 million ordinary shares with one ADS per ordinary share. Conditional scenario research only: no current value, current target, historical backtest, upside or ranking eligibility.

The raw source inputs and outputs are preserved. Three cases contain 30 annual rows, ten analyst bridge controls and positive total/IP/silicon NET investment floors. The 2.5% floors constrain arithmetic; they do not demonstrate engineering feasibility or maintenance capital requirements. Economic SBC and R&D remain in margins. The nominal $265m DreamBig cash reserve is conservative, not exact transaction PV. All quoted and unquoted equity investments receive zero bridge value. External funding suppresses headline ADS values; denominator diagnostics are not financing-adjusted fair value.

Ten display years contain six comparable/reconstructed US-GAAP annual periods and four noncomparable SoftBank segment years. Detailed source observations, all 160 original field-provenance entries and all nine guidance pairs with distinct forecast/actual dates are retained. Legacy data are never spliced into a ten-year comparable growth rate. FY2022 outstanding shares stay unknown; weighted averages do not fill the gap.

The retained independent review includes superseded earlier HOLD language; its final v2 disposition admits this dated analyst-constrained research. The 119-check source suite passed; neither source approval nor packaging checks certify the UI, financial adapter, physical manufacturing assumptions or deployment. Source-ledger-v1 freeze wording is historical and corrected by source-ledger-v2.

Only derived research and code are packaged. Raw corporate filings, full transcripts, PDFs and text extractions remain excluded and publicly linked. The source integrity manifest describes the original research freeze, including originals not shipped here; packaging-manifest-v2.json lists what is actually shipped and its hash. No original source files were modified. Imported replay_dcf.py has no write side effects; its command-line entry rewrites only outputs beside that copy. The packaged test_v2.py baseline reference is adapted to the included same-folder dcf-output-v1.json; all other source test code is preserved. Running that suite writes local validation/sensitivity outputs, so use an isolated copy when checking packaged hashes.
